# The Automation People

> The Automation People is a premier industrial automation engineering company based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. We specialize in custom control panel manufacturing, PLC programming, SCADA/HMI software development, IoT smart factory solutions, industrial valves, sensors, flow instruments, and customized machine design.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Services
- **Industrial Automation & PLC Programming**: Custom PLC system design, Siemens / Allen Bradley / Schneider PLC programming, servo motion control, vision systems, and automated control panels.
- **Process Control Systems**: Distributed control systems (DCS), PID loop tuning, temperature/pressure/flow control, and high-precision instrument calibration.
- **SCADA & Industrial Software Solutions**: Custom HMI and web-based SCADA dashboards (e.g., NetZero energy/carbon monitoring platform demo at https://tapgreen.vercel.app), database historical logging, alarming, and real-time operational analytics.
- **IoT & Smart Factory Integration**: Industry 4.0 IoT gateways, cloud telemetry, wireless sensor networks, predictive maintenance, and remote equipment monitoring.
- **Valves & Fluid Control**: Solenoid valves, motorized ball valves, butterfly valves, pneumatic control valves, and specialized custom PCB driver boards for valve automation.
- **Custom Machine Manufacturing**: Special Purpose Machines (SPM), custom assembly automation, end-of-arm tooling, and legacy machinery retrofitting.

## Product Portfolio
- **Sensors**: Proximity sensors, photoelectric sensors, ultrasonic sensors, temperature transmitters, pressure transducers, and level sensors.
- **Valves**: Pneumatic valves, motorized control valves, solenoid valves, and heavy-duty process valves.
- **Automation Components**: PLCs, HMIs, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), servo drives, relays, and power supplies.
- **Instruments**: Electromagnetic flowmeters, ultrasonic level transmitters, analytical sensors, and pressure gauges.
- **IoT Devices**: Smart IoT gateways, edge data collectors, cloud connectors, and wireless sensor modules.
